note: Frame-level operations belong to an exposure sheet or postproduction, not to the prompt (lexicon section 4).

routed_directives.editorial_recipe: Trial recipe at 24 editorial fps: 4-frame anticipation hold, then 2-frame launch transition; adapt to readability.
routed_directives.camera_rule: Keep the camera quiet during the tension hold.
routed_directives.validation: Measure the held-pose duration and verify the launch follows it without crossfading.

routed_directives.editorial_recipe: At 24 editorial fps, hold selected character drawings for 2 frames; use 1-frame drawings only at chosen fast transitions.
routed_directives.camera_rule: Keep camera motion independent from character exposure changes.
routed_directives.validation: Inspect character exposures frame by frame; do not infer twos from export fps alone.

routed_directives.editorial_recipe: Vary ink only on new drawings; hold it unchanged during repeated exposure of the same drawing.
routed_directives.camera_rule: Keep framing stable enough to distinguish contour variation from camera shake.
routed_directives.validation: Verify small contour variation without systematic landmark drift or fill flicker.

routed_directives.editorial_recipe: Align contact and any effect to the same editorial frame; hold 2 frames only if the shot uses hit-stop.
routed_directives.camera_rule: Keep the contact point unobscured in a side or three-quarter medium-wide view.
routed_directives.validation: Verify the same two named limbs meet at one contact and separate afterward.

routed_directives.editorial_recipe: Limit the star to 1 or 2 editorial frames, then clear it.
routed_directives.camera_rule: Keep the burst centered on visible contact rather than the middle of the frame.
routed_directives.validation: Check onset against contact and verify limbs are visible again on the next clean key.

routed_directives.editorial_recipe: Trial recipe: hold the contact drawing for 2 frames on a 24fps editorial timeline; generation text alone is insufficient.
routed_directives.camera_rule: Lock the camera through the contact hold unless camera shake is a separate planned overlay.
routed_directives.validation: Confirm contact is established before the hold and motion resumes afterward.

routed_directives.editorial_recipe: Use 1 editorial frame unless a deliberate 2-frame accent is authored; composite for exact placement.
routed_directives.camera_rule: Keep the same camera and contact geometry through the palette change.
routed_directives.validation: Confirm contact alignment, recognizable limbs and immediate palette restoration.

routed_directives.editorial_recipe: Trial offsets at 24 editorial fps: torso finish at t, hair peak at t+1, fabric peak at t+2; adjust to material and shot.
routed_directives.camera_rule: Keep the relevant torso and free fabric edges visible.
routed_directives.validation: Compare peak times rather than assigning one global end time to every moving part.

routed_directives.editorial_recipe: Author wide position spacing immediately after impact, tightening spacing toward the support catch.
routed_directives.camera_rule: Keep a stable framing reference so changes in displacement remain visible.
routed_directives.validation: Plot the struck shoulder's screen displacement and check it reduces during the catch.

routed_directives.editorial_recipe: Extend the track only while the heel moves in contact with the ground.
routed_directives.camera_rule: Use a low three-quarter view that shows the contacting heel and the track behind it.
routed_directives.validation: Track heel contact and groove endpoint on each sampled frame.

routed_directives.editorial_recipe: Trial recipe: 6-to-12-frame closing hold with separately authored subtle motion; do not repeatedly interpolate the whole body.
routed_directives.camera_rule: Settle the camera before the final hold.
routed_directives.validation: Check stable feet and gesture while only the planned breathing and cloth channels move.
